## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 10.06.2026 - 24.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Ani Gopinathan Pillai_, 15.07.2026, 3/5: "I used to adore this app... until it got frustrating. Now it just crashes every time I open it ... I posted this review at least 3 times in 3 years and still the app just keeps on crashing on me when I need it most..."
            2. _Technopreet Singh_, 05.07.2026, 4/5: "I'm big fan of Zoho products including your notebook app. I used this app daily, only noticed a few bugs, the major one is Notes (including collection) won't delete when I delete them. They immediately comes when I open an notebook. This problem is a little but annoying bcuz non-essential notes keep mixing up with essential ones. Hope you will take it into consideration."
            3. _Shadman Hussain_, 24.07.2026, 5/5: "I am using the Zoho notebook app for storing UPSC notes. It is a very flexible one and highly suitable for making notes. But recently, certain notes are experiencing lag and "app not responding" message is being shown frequently. I request the Zoho team to resolve the issue and make the experience seamless once again. It would be better if the team makes it robust to handle long notes."
<!--/ir-theme-->
